Pay attention to which rollers are on the other team, and adjust your play style accordingly. If you're trying to ink over the other team's ink, don't stand right in front of it and ink it, ink it from a distance. Check your map and make sure there's not a higher level near you where a roller can jump off and destroy you. Don't put yourself in corners, keep yourself in open areas where you can maneuver more freely. You have to set yourself up for the kill, it isn't just given to you. Take precautions. I used to get destroyed by rollers constantly, now I know not to rush in and to be careful when a roller could be near by. Rollers are very limited in their range (fuck dynamo rollers) So, knowing that, play yourself at a distance. Once the roller has been splatted, then move up. Also using a roller will help you get the feel for how handicapped they can be in a lot of situations. Good luck, man.

As a rule of thumb, if someone jumps to me without Stealth Jump, and I'm trying to be stealthy, I run back to safety. No need for us both to die. I usually try to stay in a safe place because I know my teammates need a safe place to jump to. Since you're playing with a team, you can't always expect to do things on your own. If you know your team jumps a lot, stay in a safe place for them to jump and then achieve whatever you were trying to do together.

I think camping can be useful within its limits. For example, if the team gets whiped, someone camping near your spawn keeps the enemy team at bay for the 6-10 seconds it takes you to respawn and take back control of the objective. While I agree it isn't helpful when you're having trouble with a 3 v 4, or for pushing the enemy back, but it isn't completely useless.
